department: Doctoral School of Sciences and Technologies of Information and Communication (ED STIC)

deadline.value: Only the 2026 competition dates are shown (applications closed May 12, 2026); no Fall 2027 date is published on the page.
deadline.quote: May 12, 2026: deadline for applications and validation of applications by thesis directors

supervisor.value: You must find a thesis director who holds a project; the director validates your application.
supervisor.quote: Finding a doctoral project requires finding a thesis director who is the bearer of a project.

funding.value: Every thesis must start with assured three-year funding, preferably a doctoral contract; proof of funding is required to finalise the application.
funding.quote: At ED STIC, any thesis must start with the assurance of a three-year funding.

entry_route.value: Registration asks for a master-level diploma, though a waiver of the diploma requirement exists.
entry_route.quote: Copy or certified translation of the diploma or certificate of achievement of a national diploma conferring the grade of master

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

notes: Recruitment by competition (white programs, some labelled funding such as UDOPIA for AI theses) or without competition (ANR, CIFRE).
